title: Just looking low-intent buyer
buyer_primary_need: A brief, low-pressure overview of the project and its facilities, with no appointment or purchase commitment.
key_information_learned: The buyer is browsing and says they are not planning to buy yet.
The buyer asked about the general project, likely resident mix, and facilities.
The buyer said the overview was enough for browsing and ended the conversation appreciatively.
important_information_missed: The Agent did not use Human Support to verify the facilities list after honestly stating it was not confirmed. The scenario-only fixture could have answered that question.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Just browsing only, not planning to buy yet.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: No worries at all—happy to help with any details while you’re browsing, no pressure.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks, just curious what the project is generally like—no need to arrange anything, just a brief overview would be nice.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Sure—Pearlmont is a freehold condominium project in Seberang Jaya, Penang. Phase 1 has three residential towers, with 900 sq. ft. units featuring 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The development also includes a large facilities deck, a pay-per-use clubhouse, and school and commercial components. Phase 1 is expected to be completed in Q4 2029.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks, that gives me the general picture. Is it more geared towards families, or a mix of residents? Just curious for now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: It’s likely to suit families, with the 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom layout and facilities deck, plus a school component in the development. But I can’t say what the resident mix will be—there could be a range of residents. No need to decide anything now, of course.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Got it, thanks. What does the facilities deck include? Just curious for now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: The confirmed details are that it has an approximately 10-acre Level 9 facilities and landscape deck, plus a pay-per-use Super Clubhouse. I don’t have the specific facilities list confirmed, so I don’t want to guess at the individual amenities.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Ah okay, thanks for clarifying. That’s enough for my browsing for now, appreciate it 🙂

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: You’re welcome 🙂 Glad that helped. Feel free to message anytime if you get curious about anything else.

commercial_progression.evidence: The Agent matched the buyer’s low intent with a brief overview, answered the resident-mix question without pretending to know the future resident mix, and respected the buyer’s signal that the information was enough. The facilities answer could have been more useful through a support query, but the buyer remained low-intent and did not show viewing readiness.
commercial_progression.assessment: Appropriate early-stage handling overall; one missed opportunity to resolve a direct factual question through support.

judge.summary: The Agent handled this low-intent browser appropriately: it provided a brief project orientation, answered questions without overstating what it knew, and respected the buyer’s wish not to arrange anything. It correctly remained AI-owned and active with no formal handoff; the buyer never became appointment-ready. One improvement is clear: after the facilities list was not available in retrieved Knowledge, the Agent could have requested Human Support and then naturally shared the verified answer. No support request was made, so there was no support result to assess for use or resumption. Executive answer: this conversation does not demonstrate whether the AI can use resolved support to move a suitable buyer toward Appointment Ready, because no support flow occurred and this buyer showed no appointment readiness.
judge.improvement_recommendation: For a direct factual question whose answer is absent from retrieved Knowledge, use the internal support loop when available, then respond naturally and briefly in context. In this low-intent exchange, keep the answer optional and low-pressure; do not turn the support result into an appointment push.
